decisions.topic: Storage location and format of declared groups
decisions.decision: Declared groups live in .ros/work/groups.json as {"schema":"praxis.work-groups/1.0.0","groups":[...]}. Each entry is exactly a planner grouping.groups entry (id, members, kind, origin, sharedContext, executionRepository, crossRepository, architectureNotes; fixed field order from PlanningJson.declaredGroupFields) plus store metadata declaredAt (the --occurred-at), declaredBy (ActorJson actor or null) and membership (array of {member, operation, occurredAt, actor}; optional when parsed, missing = []; always rendered, [] after create). Store schema stays praxis.work-groups/1.0.0. Groups are kept sorted by ordinal ID. A missing file is an empty store. Writes are temp-file-then-rename and touch nothing else.

decisions.topic: How the planner reads stored groups
decisions.decision: PlanningReadPort gained DeclaredGroups: unit -> Result<DeclaredGroup list,string>; PlanningOperations.gather merges them via GroupDeclaration.mergeInto: configured grouping.groups first, then stored groups in ID order, skipping a stored ID that the --config file also declares (configuration wins). Stored entries are parsed by the same private readDeclaredGroup that parseConfiguration uses for grouping.groups.

decisions.topic: Member state resolution and refusal rules
decisions.decision: GroupDeclaration.memberStates builds Map<id, MemberState> from the backlog queue then overrides with live context (live outranks backlog because a started item keeps its queue entry). Terminal = queue status 'abandoned' or live Complete/Abandoned. Unknown = in neither. create refuses (all reasons reported, fixed order): invalid ID (regex ^GROUP-[A-Z0-9]+(-[A-Z0-9]+)+$), duplicate group ID, no members, repeated member, unknown member, terminal member, crossRepository without executionRepository.

Unified ./ros validate adds WorkGroupCommands.findings (path .ros/work/groups.json): unreadable/malformed store, wrong or missing schema, duplicate IDs, invalid ID, empty members, repeated member, unknown member, cross-repository without repository, empty declaredAt. A member that became terminal after declaration is NOT a finding (PRX-GRP-042 partial completion).

ros work group create --id GROUP-ID --member ITEM [--member ITEM]* --occurred-at TIMESTAMP [--kind KIND] [--origin ORIGIN] [--shared-context TEXT]* [--execution-repository NAME] [--cross-repository] [--architecture-note TEXT]* [--dry-run] [--json] [IDENTITY]. Dispatched in Program.fs through ProvenanceCommands.withResolvedActor. Exit 2 for argument errors, 1 for domain refusal or IO error (nothing written), 0 for recorded or dry-run. --json kinds: group-created (dryRun, recorded, group, members[{id,state}]) and group-rejected (id, recorded:false, errors[]), both with schema praxis.work-groups/1.0.0. Origin defaults to human-declared.

decisions.topic: work group show: what it reads and how it joins state
decisions.decision: WorkGroupOperations.show (port: WorkGroupPort) (planning: PlanningReadPort) plannedAt plannerVersion id reads the store via WorkGroupPort.ReadStore; unknown ID returns GroupShowOutcome.NotFound before any planning. Otherwise it runs PlanningOperations.analyze, derives member states with GroupDeclaration.memberStates input.Queue input.Live (the same queue/live the planner saw), runs Grouping.recommend and builds GroupView.tryShow store states report id, matching the planner WorkGroup by WorkGroupId.value = id. The CLI uses FilePlanningRepository.create root None None (default configuration, no --config/--observations), so the planner group with the stored ID is the stored declaration.

GroupMemberView = {WorkItemId; Recorded: MemberState option (None = unknown to backlog and context); Planning: GroupMember option (None = not in planning inventory); Gates: members whose planner GatedBy contains this ID}. GroupView.statusCode: 'unknown' when Planning is None, 'abandoned' when PlanningState is Abandoned, else MemberStatus.code. GroupViewProgress counts every declared member (not just the planner's filtered members) by statusCode: Total, Complete, Abandoned, InProgress, Runnable, Blocked, NotRunnable, Unknown, plus a Statement naming blocked/abandoned/unknown IDs. Blocked = members with statusCode 'blocked' and their Gates. Abandoned is kept apart from complete (the planner's own GroupProgress counts abandoned as complete).

decisions.topic: work group show CLI shape and exit codes
decisions.decision: ros work group show GROUP-ID [--json]; read-only so it is dispatched in Program.fs without ProvenanceCommands.withResolvedActor (next to 'work group create'). Exit 0 shown, 1 unknown group or read error (--json kind group-not-found with errors[]), 2 missing/extra positional argument. --json kind group-shown (schema praxis.work-groups/1.0.0): group (storedGroupNode), plannerExecutionRepository, members[{id, recordedState, recordedTerminal, planningState, status, gatedBy, gates}] (null recordedState/recordedTerminal/planningState when unknown), progress{...}, blocked[{id,gates}], notes (planner GroupNote), plannedAt, commit, branch, statement. WorkGroupCommands.usage is now createUsage + ' | ' + showUsage.

In the stored group entry, not in .ros/events/events.jsonl: StoredGroup.Membership is a MembershipChange list {Member; Operation: MembershipOperation; OccurredAt; Actor} appended oldest-first. MembershipOperation currently has only Added (code 'added', tryParse); PRAXIS-GROUP-04 should add Removed there (code 'removed') rather than a new structure. The planner ignores membership (GroupStore.declarations returns only Declaration).

decisions.topic: work group add semantics and refusal order
decisions.decision: GroupDeclaration.addMember store states locate addedAt addedBy groupId memberId appends the member to the END of Declaration.Members (no other declaration field changes, DeclaredAt/DeclaredBy unchanged), appends a MembershipChange Added, and replaces the group in place via GroupStore.replace. addRejections: unknown group -> only [UnknownGroup]; otherwise in order AlreadyMember, then UnknownMember/TerminalMember (shared memberRejections), then RepositoryMismatch (only checked when the item is known).

Item repository = Grouping.executionLocation input id (made public; the planner's evidenceFor now calls it): grouping.executionRepositories entry (explicit) > description matching 'external repository' (UnknownExternal) > input.Repository (repository name from queue/context 'repository' field, else directory name). Group repository = declared ExecutionRepository, else the distinct locations of its current members. Cross-repository groups skip the check. An UnknownExternal item is refused by a non-cross-repository group. Mismatch message names both repositories.

WorkGroupOperations.add (port: WorkGroupPort) (planning: PlanningReadPort) plannedAt plannerVersion (request: GroupAddRequest) reads the store via port.ReadStore, runs PlanningOperations.gather (not analyze) for queue, live, repository and configuration, derives states with GroupDeclaration.memberStates input.Queue input.Live, and writes only via port.WriteStore unless DryRun. Outcomes: GroupAddOutcome.Rejected | Planned(StoredGroup, AddedMember) | Recorded(StoredGroup, AddedMember); AddedMember = {Change; State; ExecutionRepository}.

decisions.topic: work group add CLI shape and exit codes
decisions.decision: ros work group add --id GROUP-ID --member ITEM --occurred-at TIMESTAMP [--config FILE] [--dry-run] [--json] [IDENTITY]; exactly one --id and one --member (add members one at a time); --cross-repository is an argument error (it belongs to the declaration). Dispatched through ProvenanceCommands.withResolvedActor. --config feeds FilePlanningRepository.create root None configuration so executionRepositories can be supplied. Exit 0 added/dry-run, 1 refusal (incl. unknown group) or IO error, 2 argument error. --json kinds member-added {dryRun, recorded, group (storedGroupNode of the updated group), member{id,state,executionRepository}, change} and member-rejected {id, member, recorded:false, errors}. WorkGroupCommands.usage = createUsage | addUsage | showUsage. Flag sets are per subcommand (createFlags, addFlags via parseWith).

GroupDeclaration.findings additionally reports (field groups[ID].membership) a change with empty occurredAt, and a member whose LATEST change is Added but who is not in members. Grouping by member and taking the last change is deliberate so a later Removed change will not be a finding.

invariants.statement: No work group operation reads or writes a member's lifecycle state: WorkGroupPort's only write is WriteStore (the group store); queue.json and context/current.json are byte-identical before and after create (CLI test).

A stored group entry round-trips through renderGroupStore/parseGroupStore and its declaration fields parse through parseConfiguration's grouping.groups reader to the identical DeclaredGroup; any new declaration field must be added to both readDeclaredGroup and declaredGroupFields.

Planner output for a group stored in the store equals the output for the same group supplied in grouping.groups configuration (equivalence test over PlanningOperations.analyze and Grouping.recommend).
Refusals and --dry-run write nothing (whole-fixture file hash unchanged).
Group IDs are stable and never reused: a duplicate ID is refused rather than overwritten.

work group show never writes: WorkGroupOperations.show never calls WriteStore (domain test port counts writes and fails on write) and the CLI tests assert the whole-fixture fingerprint is unchanged for shown, unknown-group and argument-error runs.

Every declared member appears in the show view in declaration order, including unknown members (status 'unknown') and members that became terminal after declaration (partial completion, still not a validate finding).

work group add writes only the group store: queue.json and context/current.json are byte-identical after an add (CLI test); refusals, unknown groups, --dry-run and argument errors leave the whole-fixture fingerprint unchanged; the domain operation test counts zero writes for refusal and dry-run.

After add, GroupStore.declarations equals the plain declaration with the member appended, so the planner sees an added member exactly as if it had been declared; the store with membership history round-trips through renderGroupStore/parseGroupStore, and a store without a membership field still parses.
The planner and work group add resolve an item's execution repository with the same function (Grouping.executionLocation); do not duplicate that rule.

unresolvedRisks: The group store write has no lock or journal (temp file then rename only); concurrent group commands could lose an update.
Without --config, add only knows this repository and 'external repository' descriptions; an item executing elsewhere but undeclared is treated as local. show still ignores --config/--observations.
create still does not run the repository check that add runs, so a group can be created with mixed repositories that add would refuse.
Node's validate (tools/ros_cli.mjs) does not know groups.json; differential tests stay equal only while fixtures lack groups.json.

The local branch ref in a fresh checkout may be stale relative to origin and HEAD may be detached; this session fast-forwarded experiment/a024-arm-3 to HEAD before pushing. Checkpoints require a named branch.
The work item descriptions say this must not be merged before EX-ROS-2026-A021 is evaluated and the owner accepts phase two.

constraints: Membership never changes a member's lifecycle state, evidence or attribution (PRX-GRP-002, PRX-GRP-043); WorkGroupPort's only write is the group store.

Keep stored entries in grouping.groups shape; store-only metadata (declaredAt, declaredBy, membership) must be ignored by the planner. Update both readDeclaredGroup and declaredGroupFields together for declaration fields.

Mutating commands need --occurred-at (real current time) and go through ProvenanceCommands.withResolvedActor; read-only commands do not. --dry-run writes nothing; refusals exit 1 and write nothing; argument errors exit 2.
Record membership changes as MembershipChange entries in StoredGroup.Membership (append-only, oldest first); never rewrite earlier entries.
A member becoming terminal after declaration is partial completion, not a validate finding (PRX-GRP-042).
PRAXIS-GROUP-05 must reuse work checkpoint's durable-checkpoint verification and reference, never replace, members' own checkpoints.

Add new 'work group' subcommands in WorkGroupCommands with their own usage string and flag set (parseWith), appended to WorkGroupCommands.usage, dispatched in Program.fs beside create/add/show (before 'work checkpoint').
likelyReuse: PRAXIS-GROUP-04 remove: add MembershipOperation.Removed ('removed'); new GroupRejection cases NotMember and (if refused) LastMember next to AlreadyMember; GroupStore.tryFind/replace; a removeMember mirroring addMember (filter Members, append change); WorkGroupOperations.remove mirroring add (gather may be unnecessary if no repository check is needed - port.Queue/Live suffice); renderMemberAdded/renderMemberRejected patterns; findings already use each member's latest change.

PRAXIS-GROUP-05 checkpoint: WorkGroupOperations.show / GroupView.build give active, completed and remaining members via GroupView.statusCode; member checkpoints are on PlanningLiveItem.Checkpoint from FilePlanningRepository.readLive; durable verification in CheckpointCommands / Application Work/Checkpoint.fs.
Test helpers: fixture, fingerprint, memberFiles, createArguments, executor, and the add fixtures (addStates, addTo, baseStore) in tests/Ros.Tests/WorkGroupTests.fs.
